greeting: Astronomer Nova on comms. Stage 2: Stellar Observers. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running Sky Sanctuary. Objective drift gets teams buried.
I saw gravity file for overtime in this sector. Management approved.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Study the stellar anomalies.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Study the stellar anomalies; Decode the extradimensional signals; Decide whether to make contact. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Investigate the strange signals from beyond Chroma's sky. Immediate move: Study the stellar anomalies.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 2 resolved: Stellar Observers. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for The Sky Gardens.
rumor: A cloud ferry arrived before it departed and still demanded full fare.
People keep repeating one clue from Stellar Observers: 'Decide whether to make contact'.
I met my future self and we argued about shoe durability.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn in Aetherreach is clear-sky math: low noise, high visibility, best scouting window.
dialog.time_noon: Noon stacks wind traffic and patrol traffic together. Plan your crossings.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk paints false horizons here. Verify every ledge before committing.
dialog.time_night: Night turns cloud light into mirages. Keep formation and call targets out loud.

party_reactions.kade: Astronomer Nova sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Astronomer Nova accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Astronomer Nova talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.
